findings.text: follow-on: the end-to-end wiring is unexercised. crew_follow computes reloaded_in_place = _FOLLOWER_CHECKPOINT_ENV in os.environ before popping the checkpoint (reckon/cli.py:3764), and _FollowerReloader.poll sets that variable for every non-seat reload whatever the checkpoint holds (reckon/cli.py:2274), but the test injects reloaded_in_place directly, so a regression at either end — the reloader failing to set the variable, or it being read after the checkpoint is popped — would leave all five cases green.

follow-on: the fresh-arming immediate-report branch (reloaded_in_place False) has no case; every _events call uses the default True, so a regression that wrongly deferred a fresh arming — the case that must report at once, having no proof the code moved — would not be caught.

follow-on: the manifest's after_suite command omits the PYTHONPATH prefix its own arms-head.log header carries, so the recorded command is not literally the one that ran; the run cannot be re-executed from the manifest line alone.

item_verdicts.diff: read a1146a6e against base e89a94bd; reckon/cli.py derives PRODUCER_RELOAD_WINDOW_SECONDS (65.0 s) from _FOLLOWER_RELOAD_PROBE_TIMEOUT + PRODUCER_POLL_INTERVAL_CAP_SECONDS + PRODUCER_RELOAD_WINDOW_MARGIN_SECONDS, mirrors the producer idle poll cap (30.0 s) with a drift-guard test, replaces the non-empty-checkpoint gate with reloaded_in_place read from _FOLLOWER_CHECKPOINT_ENV before the checkpoint is consumed (reckon/cli.py:3764), and adds the empty-checkpoint and default-window cases.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names tests/test_stale_producer_warning_waits_for_its_reload.py driving a sub-window seat (no advice) and a past-window seat (advice), plus a default-window adequacy case and an empty-checkpoint reload case, with zero added failures across the two arm files; the manifest records gate 5 passed EXIT=0 and both arms 8 passed EXIT=0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the follower warns of a stale producer only once the producer has had its reload window to catch up; reckon/cli.py:3091 _producer_code_events defers a mismatch first seen on the in-place-reload path, showing a producer-reloading note inside the window, and commit a1146a6e sizes that window from the reload's own bounds and keys the deferral on reloaded_in_place rather than on a non-empty checkpoint.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; status complete, commits 3213f8dd and a1146a6e, recording gate 5 passed EXIT=0, arms base e89a94bd 8 passed and head a1146a6e 8 passed, zero added failures, and a genuine three-mutation negative control that reddens each time.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the declared paths are reckon/cli.py, tests/test_stale_producer_warning_waits_for_its_reload.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-crew-process-ends-with-its-owner/stale-producer-warning-waits-for-its-reload.html; the full diff e89a94bd..a1146a6e touches exactly those three, and commit a1146a6e alone does too.

justifications.durability: the tests assert the reloading note without advice inside the window, the advice past it, the empty-checkpoint reload, and that the shipped window exceeds a slow reload's worst case, with the mirrored cap pinned to the producer's own; a mutation disabling the deferral leaves 2 of 5 green, and disabling only the empty-checkpoint gate leaves the empty-checkpoint case red.
justifications.evidence: logs/gate-head.log records 5 passed EXIT=0 at a1146a6e, arms-base 8 passed and arms-head 8 passed with zero added, and the three-mutation control reddens the expected cases; reproduced independently at a git-archive export of a1146a6e (5 passed EXIT=0) with one mutation turning 3 cases red, but the manifest's after_suite command omits the PYTHONPATH prefix its own arms-head.log header carries, so the recorded command is not literally the one that ran.
justifications.fit: PRODUCER_RELOAD_WINDOW_SECONDS / PRODUCER_POLL_INTERVAL_CAP_SECONDS / FOLLOWER_PRODUCER_RELOADING_EVENT follow the surrounding FOLLOWER_* family, the nested _producer_code_events helper matches the _follow_watch_lines idiom at reckon/cli.py:3048, and the comments describe mechanism with no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/cli.py:3091 defers a mismatch first seen while reloading and emits the cycle advice only past the window; commit a1146a6e closes both gaps the prior review recorded at head 3213f8dd — the window is now derived and its adequacy asserted, and the deferral keys on the image having reloaded rather than on the checkpoint being non-empty.
justifications.scope_discipline: the diff e89a94bd..a1146a6e and commit a1146a6e alone touch exactly the three declared write paths and no file outside them.
